trial_court: CIVIL JUDGE-07, (CENTRAL), TIS HAZARI COURTS, DELHI - CS SCJ No. : 94173/16
case_name: Neeraj Dhawan vs The Branch Manager, State Bank Of India

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Neeraj Dhawan, Director Of M/S Mega Grain Trading Co. Pvt. Ltd.
parties.respondent_defendant: The Branch Manager, State Bank Of India

facts_of_case: Plaintiff presented cheque to defendant bank on 25.07.2014. Defendant bank sent cheque for clearance twice but did not clear it. Plaintiff deposited cheque within limitation period but suffered due to defendant's fault.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the plaintiff to prove that he has been authorised by the company to file the suit.
legal_principles.held: PW1 was cross examined at length on 02.04.16 and was discharged on the same day.

legal_principles.principle: A board resolution authorising the plaintiff to prosecute a matter can be taken on record in view of Order VII Rule 14.
legal_principles.held: Board resolution was taken on record in view of the order on Order VII rule 14 of this court on 15.11.18.

outcome.final_order: Plaintiff is entitled to recover Rs. 2,00,000/- and costs of the suit.

keywords: M/S Mega Grain Trading Co. Pvt. Ltd.
use_for_drafting: understanding the role of a director in a company
